issues_detected.description: The record is an undeclared mapping whose four Dataverse releases sit under resources, so each release is a scored unit; the descriptive, funding, ethics, processing and bias metadata live only on the parent mapping and are not inherited by any release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare the record as a Dataset (conforms_to_class) if the series is the dataset to score, or give each release its own descriptive, governance and bias metadata.

issues_detected.description: The October 2025 and June 2026 releases list only ZIP archives with no inner file types, conformance declaration or download/access steps.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the file types inside each archive, the RO-Crate conformance and the access path.

issues_detected.description: Release-level versioning is limited to a version number and dates; maintenance, errata and derivation links between successive releases are not recorded on the releases.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record per-release change notes, derivation from the prior release and maintainers.

issues_detected.description: Each release gives only the license name; no restrictions, confidentiality level or explicit use guidance.
issues_detected.recommendation: Attach license_and_use_terms, ip_restrictions and use guidance to each release.

issues_detected.description: Release descriptions are specific but no release states a purpose, collection timeframe, second reference or donor characterization.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add purposes, collection timeframes, related publications and cell-line characterization per release.

issues_detected.description: Version headers disagree with citation versions (1.4 vs V1, 2.1 vs V2, 2.0 vs V2), and the June 2026 release date conflicts between cm4ai.org (2025) and Dataverse (2026); both are disclosed in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep the disclosed caveats; prefer the repository's version identifier consistently.

issues_detected.description: The June 2025 release declares 21 files but describes only 10 (disclosed); image-protein counts differ across releases (563, 464).
issues_detected.recommendation: Enumerate all files or state the omission in total_file_count context.

semantic_insights: Scope: the input has no Dataset/CoreDataset declaration and four nonempty resources, so the four Dataverse releases are the scored units and each item score is the minimum across them.

The parent mapping documents creators with ORCIDs, NIH award OT2OD032742, ethics contacts, governance, intended/prohibited uses, known biases and processing pipelines; none of this is scored because it is not inherited by the releases.
Release-level DOIs (10.18130 prefix, UVA Dataverse) are well-formed and match formal citations.
human_subjects, shared_dataset, data_collection and data_processing are undeclared by the caller, so Q8, Q10-Q13, Q15 and Q17 stay applicable.

strengths: Every release has a DOI, version, issue date and formal citation
Release file lists carry md5 checksums and media types
weaknesses: Releases carry no descriptive, funding, ethics, use-guidance or bias metadata of their own
Recent releases document only ZIP containers
recommendations: Declare the series as a Dataset or populate per-release metadata
Describe archive contents, sizes and conformance per release
